Kael • Character & Animation Study

The illustration is a concept target. The playable character now uses a customized anatomical skinned GLB with arm IK and finger bones. Base mesh: Young Warrior by Girush (CC0 / Public Domain), https://opengameart.org/content/base-rigged-stylized-humanoid-character-yw. Original Kael clothing, armor and weapons were added for this game. Facial expressions and cloth motion remain simplified. Rendering uses banded cel lighting plus an inverted-hull outline (extra draw calls on the skinned meshes).

Tap LMB on release for a four-hit combo. Queue the next tap after halfway through the current attack. Hold at least 0.18s for a heavy attack: level 1 below 0.5s (12 stamina), level 2 at 0.5s (22), level 3 at 1.2s (32); maximum 2s. Normal attacks cost 8 stamina. Q charges up to 1.5s and costs 15–30; E up to 2s and costs 20–35. Release to cast and begin cooldown. Charging slows movement; attacks plant the feet.

Exploration or Combat Idle allows attack, charge, skill, block or dodge. A light attack allows a buffered tap after 50%; recovery allows dodge after 72%. Dodge cancels charging and costs 15 stamina. Strong damage interrupts; weak hits do not. Blocking prevents charging. Pause, inventory, focus loss and cursor-release clear held actions without casting. Insufficient stamina at release cancels cleanly. R consumes 100 energy for Wind Vortex.

Physics controls position and jump; animation only moves the visual joints. Blade hits use sampled swept segments during the active window and one hit per enemy per swing. E projectiles maintain a separate per-enemy hit set. Jump uses a fixed 120Hz integrator, buffered input, coyote time and triangle-matched terrain grounding. Linear sky capture, PMREM reflections and sRGB output preserve material lighting.
